journal.description.alexscaves.radgill: Hideously mutated, these three-eyed fish can occasionally be seen leaping from the acid into the air.
journal.description.alexsmobs.cosmic_cod: Hydrophobic and damaged by water, instead found floating through the ether of The End.
journal.description.alexsmobs.blobfish: Though naturially grey and compressed in deep oceans, they become a pink pile of sludge under less pressure.
journal.description.alexsmobs.flying_fis: Occasionally can be seen leaping out of the water and gliding through the air.
journal.description.alexscaves.sea_pig: Gelatinous invertebrates, slowly trudging along the sea floor, sifting through muck to find food.
journal.description.alexscaves.tripodfis: Though these bizzare fish are decent swimmers, they can often be spotted resting above the seafloor on the 3 spines emerging from their fins.
journal.description.alexscaves.lanternfi: Makes up for its diminutive size for the large shoals of them found throughout the waters of the Abyss Chasm.
journal.description.alexscaves.sweetish_: Only seen swimming through underground rivers of Purple Soda. Appears to be made of living candy.

journal.description.aquamirae.spinefish: The skeleton-esque appearance of these fish allow them to thrive, ignored by predators.
journal.description.cataclysm.lionfish: Aggressive and kept by Deepling Anglers, these fish can shoot off a bunch of spines.
journal.description.miners_delight.squid: A common cephalopod , mostly known for their source of ink sacs.
journal.description.miners_delight.glow_: A common cephalopod, often found underground. There is much debate on their purpose.
